title: On Fuzzy Partial Differential Equations for A-Linearly Interactive Fuzzy Complex Processes: Sobolev Spaces and Fourier Analysis
summary: This article develops a mathematical framework to handle fuzzy partial differential equations (PDEs) using Sobolev spaces defined over A-linearly interactive complex fuzzy processes. We introduce the notion of weak derivative in the fuzzy sense to define fuzzy Sobolev spaces that preserve key analytical properties. Furthermore, we introduce a fuzzy Fourier transform adapted to this context and explore its main properties.
